description.intro: The Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa is nestled in the heart of the Royal Thalassa Monastir, between Monastir and Sousse, close to the airport and on one of Tunisia's most beautiful beaches, often lagoon-like.
description.detail: Housing three prestigious international brands, the Royal Elyssa meets all physical, psychological and aesthetic wellness needs (sports, fitness, thalassotherapy, spa, hairdressing, relaxation...), while offering exceptional and luxurious accommodation, the VIP Square Spa Suites.

paragraphs.p1: THALION has been a partner of Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa since its opening in late 2010.
paragraphs.p2: A highly reputed French brand in the world of thalassotherapy and spa, THALION, in Brittany, in the Iroise Sea, carefully harvests and selects the best seaweed while preserving their original qualities to restore them in innovative formulas, true elixirs of beauty and well-being.
paragraphs.p3: Expert in marine cosmetics, THALION provides its professional treatments in thalassotherapy centers, spas and institutes in more than fifty countries around the world.

paragraphs.p1: The Eric Zemmour Salon in Monastir, located within the Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa. It offers you a full range of services (hairdressing, aesthetics) listed in our brochure.
paragraphs.p1Mobile: The Eric Zemmour Salon in Monastir, located within the Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa, is open from Friday to Wednesday, from 10am to 7pm. It offers you a full range of services (hairdressing, aesthetics) listed in our brochure.
paragraphs.p2: It features a VIP Space for those who desire above all their tranquility, away from the hustle and bustle of the salon, and is also used for our brides.
paragraphs.p3: The Eric Zemmour Salon is the only hair salon in Monastir to use KERASTASE products for its clients.
paragraphs.p4: To make an appointment or get information about our services:

paragraphs.phoneMobile: T. +216 73 520 591, from 10am to 7pm Friday to Wednesday

paragraphs.p1: For the body to regain its place, we had to invent a resolutely different concept: l'Usine. A place, a past and a team that send back to a dark past the vision you had of sports clubs.
paragraphs.p2: At L'Usine Monastir, the first sensation that strikes you is the light and the view of the Mediterranean, very close by.
paragraphs.p3: A concept designed to showcase a unique architectural setting that creates a soothing atmosphere conducive to concentration for a single objective: the fullness of body and mind in the magnificent setting of the Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa in Monastir.
paragraphs.p4: Our team of five coaches, all trained in the demanding concept of l'Usine, will know how to transform your moments of sport into moments of happiness repeated at will.

paragraphs.p1: You have a choice for your accommodation: either you can stay at the Royal Thalassa Monastir*****, directly connected to the Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa, or you will prefer to live in the heart of our center, on the second floor, in the magnificent VIP Square Spa Suites, composed of twenty suites, overlooking both lush hanging gardens, the nearby Mediterranean and a private pool, exclusively reserved for VIP Square residents.
paragraphs.p2: The Spa Suites are luxuriously decorated in a contemporary and refined style. They feature spacious bathrooms and some even offer you jacuzzis on their private terraces.
paragraphs.p3: If you stay in our VIP square, you can easily access all our thalasso and spa spaces directly in a bathrobe.

biography.intro: Since childhood, Eric Zemmour has been passionate about hairdressing. Thanks to L'Oréal Professional, of which he is one of the ambassadors, he is among the hairdressers who originated French High-End Hairdressing, an avant-garde concept that made his success.
biography.journey: For Eric Zemmour, the decision to become a professional hairdresser was obvious from his early childhood, as he grew up in this universe throughout his youth thanks to his family. It was therefore natural for him to attend a hairdressing school to become professional.
biography.success: And very quickly, the young man achieved great success! But for him, there's no need to multiply hair salons: his name is associated with only about ten establishments, but all are considered the cream of hair salons: refined, modern and comfortable spaces where 80 carefully selected collaborators work.
biography.recognition: Thanks to his talent, Eric Zemmour quickly gained recognition from his peers and was spotted by L'Oréal Professional, who decided to name him ambassador hairdresser. A title that notably allows him to perform around the world, creating live on stage hairstyles that are increasingly artistic.
biography.tunisia: In love with Tunisia, Eric Zemmour established his brand in MONASTIR from the opening of Royal Elyssa Thalasso & Spa in 2010.

header.subtitle: Discover our complete range of fitness activities designed for all levels and all goals

attack.name: Attack
attack.description: The ultimate cardio workout, inspired by aerobics and athletics. This class works on endurance and strength, combining self-improvement and physical fitness.

boxe.name: Boxing
boxe.description: Intense sports activity where you work on breathing and stamina to gain endurance. Boxing helps you become more alert, agile and fast.

combat.name: Combat
combat.description: Mix between intensive cardio and high-level martial arts movements: karate, boxing, taekwondo. A complete and energizing discipline.

crossTraining.name: Cross Training
crossTraining.description: Very complete activity with varied exercises in rapid succession. 30 short but very effective minutes alternating cardio and muscle strengthening.

step.name: Step
step.description: Fitness sport on steps developing cardiovascular endurance, rhythm, coordination and memorization. Accessible to all levels.

pilates.name: Pilates
pilates.description: The Club's novelty! Method inspired by yoga, dance and gymnastics. Floor practice with apparatus and proprioceptive accessories.

pump.name: Pump
pump.description: Very intense muscle strengthening designed to sculpt your silhouette in minimum time. Try it and you'll love it!

spinning.name: Spinning
spinning.description: Cardio-training on stationary bikes with music! Open to all ages and accessible to everyone. Energizing session guaranteed.

taebo.name: Taebo
taebo.description: Mix of boxing and taekwondo with rhythmic music. Created by Billy Blanks, American taekwondo champion.

trx.name: TRX
trx.description: Total Resistance Exercises in suspension with straps. Intense and complete course to work muscles differently!

yoga.name: Yoga
yoga.description: Vinyasa, Ashtanga, Stretch - spiritual and physical disciplines to free the mind through mastery of movement and breath.

danseOrientale.name: Oriental Dance
danseOrientale.description: Classic, fluid and elegant style born in Egypt. Ample, supple and refined movements in an enchanting atmosphere.

bachata.name: Bachata
bachata.description: Sensual dance born in the Dominican Republic. Hip movements and swaying to romantic music.

groupTraining.title: Group Training classes, always at the cutting edge!
groupTraining.description1: Our group classes are one of the pillars of our L'Usine Sports Club. Led by professional and certified coaches, our classes always stay in line with novelties and innovation to allow you to always be up to date in your sports activities in our Club.
groupTraining.description2: All our teams remain at your disposal to learn more about any discipline.

personalTraining.title: Personal Training to precisely meet your expectations
personalTraining.description1: Do you need to achieve goals, take or retake control of yourself, better control your health? Personal Training, with one of our coaches, will undoubtedly be the appropriate answer.
personalTraining.description2: The Masters of L'Usine sports club organize and plan your individual sports training according to your objectives. They build a tailor-made plan that evolves according to progress, age, seasons and everyone's rhythms. An individual offer that combines monitoring, training, recovery. Nutritional and lifestyle advice can also be given to perfect your transformation.

header.title: OUR
header.subtitle: Exceptional coaches dedicated to your transformation

team.title: L'USINE'S ELITE TEAM
team.description1: Highly qualified and motivated, L'Usine coaches are graduates of Higher Sports Education Institutions. Coming from different specialties, their academic and complementary training is focused on the practice of sports and artistic physical activities, allowing them to continuously approach coaching with new techniques, always at the cutting edge.
team.description2: The coaches of our team are selected on very strict criteria, not only in relation to their sporting level, but are also controlled on their behavior and their attitude towards members, on the one hand, and their colleagues, on the other hand.
team.description3: It should also be noted that our coaches are, as a whole, trained in first aid techniques, to deal with any emergency within the Club.

dropdown.nosServicesTagline: Experience a unique marine treatment journey.

cover.subtitle: marine cosmetic creator
cover.description: For men or women, in treatments or care, full of information and practical details (including a glossary), our Thalion brochure opens all the doors to well-being, relaxation and aesthetics... Browse it with us, we obviously remain at your complete disposal to tell you more.

lieuSoins.title: The place,
lieuSoins.subtitle: the treatment spaces
lieuSoins.description: Thanks to its 4 treatment spaces that make the magic of the place, THALION reveals a new way to experience thalassotherapy, a unique experience!

aquatique.title: AQUATIC SPACE
aquatique.description: Beyond the majestic bay windows, open to the ocean, the immense seawater pool impresses and invites you to dive in to enjoy the marine course with its whirlpool baths, waterfalls and underwater hydro-massaging jets.

hydrotherapie.title: HYDROTHERAPY SPACE
hydrotherapie.description: Surrounded by green patios, this space is animated by a technical platform of unequaled quality in Tunisia. Chromotherapy baths, Water beds, Underwater Shower, Watermass, these cutting-edge equipment participate in awakening all your senses thanks to the alternation of scents and colors offering unique sensations. The treatments continue with a range of marine scrubs, seaweed wraps with amazing variations, and affusion treatments with organic sea samphire.

hammam.title: HAMMAM SPACE
hammam.description: In a refined setting, embark on a journey to the heart of Maghreb traditions. Heat Experience, Hammam Latitudes, Duo Seaweed and Clay Ceremony, experience a multi-sensory journey combining the benefits of the marine universe with the ancestral virtues of the hammam. Open your travel diary!

serenite.title: SERENITY SPACE
serenite.description: In this place bathed in light, well-being & serenity are the key words. Enjoying a splendid view of the hanging gardens and sunny terraces, discover our rich and creative massage menu, treat yourself to a beneficial break after your treatments in our rest room, or enjoy an infusion at the herbal tea bar. A timeless parenthesis to take care of yourself and your body.
